Decision Title: Missing Commercial Ex-GST Purchase Rates on Historical Receipts
Original Problem Statement: External GRN receipts cannot establish weighted-average inventory valuation or cost journals without commercial purchase rates.
Verified Source Facts: Workbook VSPL_Material_Entry.xlsx sheet 3. Receipt GRN contains 4 transaction rows (rows 2 to 5). The worksheet contains no unit price or rate_ex_gst column by design (Readme: Phase 1: quantities only (no prices)). Item Master rate column is 100% empty (0/391). Legacy Store Inventory also contains 0 populated rates.
Outstanding Evidence & Technical Finding: Rates cannot be inferred from current market prices or later transactions. Vendor invoices must be audited: Row 2 (Inv 096 / PO 110726-02); Row 3 (Inv GMP2926002828 / PO 300426-10); Row 4 (Inv 454 / PO 070726-11); Row 5 (Inv 384 / PO 140726-02).
Proposed Resolution: Stage receipts with status DRAFT and rate_ex_gst=NULL. Require Finance to approve audited ex-GST invoice rates before any live ledger posting.
Migration / Ledger Impact: BLOCKING for Phase 6 live costing engine. Physical quantities can be staged in draft but cannot form valid weighted-average cost basis.
History Log: v1 (2026-10-13): Created in Stage 2 as PENDING_REVIEW; v2 (2026-10-13): Reconciled in Stage 2.1 confirming 0/391 rates in Item Master and legacy archive.

Decision Title: Treatment of July 2026 Historical Data Relative to 12-Oct-2026 Costing Cutoff
Original Problem Statement: Costing start date is configured as 12 October 2026 while historical source transactions span 08-Jul-2026 to 22-Jul-2026.
Verified Source Facts: 558 Issue rows, 4 GRN rows, 6 Waste rows, and 19 Furnace Heats occur in July 2026. An 82-day calendar gap exists between last transaction date (22-Jul-2026) and cutoff (12-Oct-2026); an 89-day gap exists from interim ledger update date (15-Jul-2026). Zero electronic records exist for Aug/Sep 2026.
Outstanding Evidence & Technical Finding: Intervening August-September physical movements and inventory adjustments are undocumented in electronic files. July closing balances cannot be assumed equal to October opening balances without a physical stock audit.
Proposed Resolution: Present three distinct cutoff-policy scenarios: (a) Historical audit archive without live posting; (b) Reconstructed opening position as of 12-Oct-2026 via physical stocktake; (c) Two-phase ledger reconstruction if gap evidence is provided. Management approval required.
Migration / Ledger Impact: BLOCKING for entire migration execution. Dictates whether July records ever post to append-only ledger or remain read-only audit archive.
History Log: v1 (2026-10-13): Created in Stage 2 with 3 scenarios; v2 (2026-10-13): Reconciled in Stage 2.1 detailing exact 82-day/89-day gap and ledger invariant implications.

Decision Title: Reconciliation of Seven Negative Closing Stock Balances
Original Problem Statement: Interim Master Ledger displays negative closing stock balances for 7 raw materials: FDY-RM-008 (-500 kg), FDY-RM-011 (-300 kg), FDY-RM-014 (-2 kg), FDY-RM-016 (-15 kg), FDY-RM-017 (-3 kg), FDY-RM-019 (-150 kg), FDY-RM-020 (-5 kg).
Verified Source Facts: These 7 negative figures exactly match the charged quantities of furnace heat H-260714-01 in Charge Details. Interim ledger mistakenly treated furnace charges as store issues. Furthermore, store issues in 4. Issue total 11793 kg for 008, 278.5 kg for 017, and 50.2 kg for 020, which were completely omitted from the interim ledger.
Outstanding Evidence & Technical Finding: Zero opening balances were recorded in Master Ledger. Legacy Store Inventory holds unposted physical stock for Inoculant 15 (92.5 kg), Magnesium (550 kg), Manganese (20 kg), and Silicon (26 kg), but lacks opening stock for Scrap, Gatings, and Pig Iron.
Proposed Resolution: Do not post furnace charges as store issues (enforce Phase 5 Rule H1). Conduct comprehensive physical stocktake. Require Plant Head approval for opening balances.
Migration / Ledger Impact: BLOCKING for inventory ledger integrity. Append-only ledger forbids negative balances unless overridden by explicit management policy.
History Log: v1 (2026-10-13): Created in Stage 2 as PENDING_REVIEW; v2 (2026-10-13): Reconciled in Stage 2.1 with full heat charge correlation, legacy receipt analysis, and store issue quantification.
